read.title: Read a document
read.finder_hint: Search the forest and open a document to read.
read.finder_placeholder: Search by title, summary or tag…
read.finder_empty: Nothing matched. Try other words, or browse in Explore.
read.share_hint: A link that shows this document to somebody without an account. It expires, and you can revoke it here.
read.share_once: Copy it now — the link is shown only once.
read.finder_more: There are more matches than one search can carry. Narrow the term, or use Explore, which reads the texts too.
read.finder_scent_only: Titles, summaries and tags only — never the texts. Explore reads those too.
